name: Code Block
description: Read-only code panel with light syntax highlighting, line numbers, highlighted ranges, language tabs, soft-wrap toggle, collapse, secret redaction and clipboard copy with fallback.

props.name: code
props.description: Source to render (ignored when tabs is set)

props.name: tabs
props.type: { label: string; code: string; language?: CodeLanguage }[]
props.description: Variants of the same snippet, arrow-key navigable

props.name: filename
props.description: Header label when there are no tabs

props.name: highlightLines
props.description: Lines or ranges to highlight, e.g. [2, "5-7"]

props.name: maxLines
props.description: Collapse beyond this many lines with a Show all toggle

props.name: redact
props.description: Mask matches in the view; copy keeps the real text
